descrizione: Celebrate Ferragosto, one of Italy’s most beloved summer traditions, with us! ☀️
descrizione-lunga: Join us for a special evening of aperitivo, authentic Italian pizza, and good vibes. 🍹🍕 What is Ferragosto? Ferragosto is Italy’s traditional August 15th celebration — a day dedicated to summer, holidays, good food, and spending time together. 🇮🇹❤️ Come enjoy a little taste of Italian summer in Vienna!
